name: MINE
source:
Welcome to the dark and twisted game of 'MINE'. Prepare to be entangled in a chilling game where Keith, consumed by a relentless obsession, will stop at nothing to captivate and win over the player's heart. As the player, you must solve perplexing puzzles, through a series of gripping challenges and heart-pounding encounters. Explore the depths of their twisted psyche, discover their obsessive motives and find a way to escape. The choice is yours in this riveting tale of love.

[From [url=https://yamie-es.itch.io/mine-find-the-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到黑暗扭曲的《MINE》。準備好捲入一場令人不寒而慄的遊戲：基思被無休止的執念吞噬，為迷住玩家、贏得芳心，將不擇手段。你必須在一連串扣人心弦的挑戰與驚險邂逅中，解開令人費解的謎題。深入他扭曲的內心，發現偏執背後的動機，尋找逃脫之路。在這個引人入勝的愛情故事中，選擇權屬於你。

[摘自[url=https://yamie-es.itch.io/mine-find-the-story]Itch.io[/url]]
